text: Seawater piping, underground, shall be GRP, in accordance with ALP-EPC-00000-PI-SPC-0007 and ALP-EPC-00000-PI-MRQ-0004, with concrete thrust blocks or restraints for bends, buried with sand bedding and protection against traffic load; steel fittings (flanges, valves) shall be lined or of super duplex per ALP-EPC-00000-ME-RPT-0002.
